name: European walking route E9, Milford on Sea to Queen Elizabeth Country Park
description_md:
The European walking route E9 extends 113.7 km from Milford on Sea to Queen Elizabeth Country Park. This waymarked hiking route is part of an international waymarked hiking network and is signposted as E9.

The route involves 465 m of ascent and 593 m of descent. It is classified as hard based on the distance and ascent. The walking time is about 30 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The path passes the Royal Victoria Hospital Museum within 100 m and Exbury Gardens within 1400 m.
